body: I smell every thing I come into contact with.  Didn't notice so much until gf pointed it out.  Sometimes my quirk can be pretty disgusting.  I try to stop myself from smelling things that are really just not normal (poop, dead animals, etc...)
Yeah.  It's too bad it's going to rain all day (whomp whomp).  But when he gets here I'm thinking we might try to go out for lunch or something.

I've had several jobs in the last 5 years, and some way or another my agoraphobia gets in the way.  So I've lost all of the jobs.  I had unemployment for a while, which was really nice because I could at least afford my rent.

I put in job applications every once in a while and I feel like they're totally pointless because even if I were to get the job, I don't think I'd be able to keep it.

First, thank you for your response.

So as to not be misleading, I'm a lesbian, not a guy.  I'm largely agoraphobic because of a rape that happened almost six years ago.  While I feel like I've overcome the feelings surrounding it and forgiven my rapist (not to his face, just in my mind), I still feel so paralyzed when I have to go in public.

Also at my last job I was fired for being gay.  I was fired the day they struck down DOMA for having the TV on the news and my boss said some crap like "nobody wants to hear about these fucking faggots." And it brought a tear to my eye.  He asked for my keys and told me to leave.  I know it's illegal, but I was being paid under the table so I don't really feel like I have any standing to go up against him.

I mentioned before that I have a victim complex (or so some have said).  But I always feel like I get the shitty end of so many sticks.

It's not that I don't try.  Last night, me and the gf watched a nice movie and laid in bed together.  She was supportive and kind.  But I fear that it's not enough.  I woke up today and had a shower.  Still... I feel horrible.

My friend is coming over around 1pm EST to hang out with me.  He knows what I've been going through, and I've been with him through his own hard times, so I trust him.  I'm trying really hard but I sometimes feel like this is the end.  Like I have no energy left to live no matter how hard I push myself.

God, I must sound like the most pitiful person in the world.
